(Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first humeral surface component removably attached to a second component.

(Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first humeral surface component is a humeral surface and said second component is a removably attached stem.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface component to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is spherically or elliptically shaped.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral surface component.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface for bony ingrowth material.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a smooth articulating surface.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has a length wherein said stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem.

(Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a screw.

(Currently Amended) A glenohumeral joint implant comprising a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and an implant.

(Currently Amended) The glenohumeral joint implant of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

(Currently Amended) A repaired humeral implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem, wherein said stem is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.

(Currently Amended) The repaired humeral implant of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

(Currently Amended) The repaired humeral implant of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.
